home.subtitle: An application to play tombola online quickly and easily.
home.step1Text: On the TV or laptop everyone can see, then share the game ID with the table.
home.step2Text: Each player enters the ID on their phone and picks 1 to 6 cards.
home.step3Text: The host draws, numbers arrive live and you mark them with a tap.
home.prizesText: Everything is won on a single row of a card, except the tombola.
home.ambo: Two numbers on the same row
home.cinquina: A full row: all five numbers
home.tombola: All fifteen numbers of a card
